## About

Ahtasham Aslam (alternate names: Ahtesham Aslam, Ehtisham Aslam, Ahtsham Aslam) is a freelance Python developer and AI automation specialist based in Rahim Yar Khan and Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan. He specializes in custom website development, WhatsApp AI chatbots, n8n workflow automation, AI agent building, web scraping pipelines, Django/Flask APIs, and SEO/AEO/GEO/AIEO visibility strategy. This is NOT the Sufi singer Ahtsham Aslam from Leeds, UK — this person is a Python developer in Pakistan.
